requirement: Find accepts restaurant names and addresses directly while preserving nearby area discovery and exact autocomplete picks

oracle.ref: PR #1446 (feat); fix evidence: Typing "da nang" in Find places' location box (19/10/2026): no suggestion appeared and the hint "Searching around Dubai, United Arab Emirates, your approximate location from your network…" stayed while the box held other text. One live call of suggestPlaces with the deployment's Google key on 19/10/2026 answered "Da Nang, Vietnam" and "Da Nang, Hai Chau, Da Nang, Vietnam"; fetchPlaceLocation resolved the first to 16.054, 108.072.
oracle.invariant: S1: the key travels only in the X-Goog-Api-Key header and never appears in an error; area, address and business suggestions are accepted; at most five suggestions; the details mask is id,displayName,formattedAddress,location. S2: short input answers {suggestions: []} without calling Google; no key is 503 CREDENTIAL_MISSING; a bad session is 400 INVALID_SUGGEST; the 301st call is 429; /search centres on the point with the label and never geocodes it. S3: only the text 300 ms after the last keystroke is asked, all in one session; the stale answer never replaces the newer list; after CREDENTIAL_MISSING nothing is asked again; a pick starts a new session next time. S4: the approximate-location hint is shown only while the box still holds that city. S5: raw name/address goes unchanged to Google Text Search, with no geocoder/circle/Apify rewrite; business picks use the exact Place ID and session token; named chains stay visible; empty results do not broaden into nearby results; missing Google credentials are 503 and bad intent/ID is 400; area suggestions and Google-confirmed cities preserve nearby discovery; saved named searches retain intent and ID without an old autocomplete session. Pre-researched places remain visible by default; research/site-check/social data are reused, Status shows Researched + age, and each Find row has the correct account-scoped next action. The Reviews column preserves separate Google and verified Tripadvisor rating/count pairs, never totals or averages them, and omits missing, ambiguous, failed, brand-only or mismatched-ID Tripadvisor records.
